profile.headline: Software Engineer at Wells Fargo
profile.summary: "No matter what people tell you, words and ideas can change the world."

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led architecture and delivery of cloud-native Java microservices (Spring Boot) using Clean Architecture, deployed on Kubernetes/OpenShift with MongoDB, Redis, and Kafka, supporting scalable, high-throughput distributed systems.
	•	Transformed legacy batch processing of 450K+ daily records into a real-time, event-driven Kafka architecture, reducing processing latency from 24 hours to near real-time (~95–99% improvement) and eliminating batch dependencies.
	•	Designed and implemented event-driven and message-driven systems processing millions of events/day, enabling scalable data aggregation, compliance validation, and seamless multi-service integrations.
	•	Built highly resilient services using Resilience4j (circuit breakers, retries, rate limiting) and dead-letter queue patterns, improving system stability and reducing production incidents.
	•	Implemented secure, contract-first API integrations using OAuth 2.0 and OpenAPI 3.0, managing ingress/egress via Apigee proxies for enhanced security, traffic control, and governance.
	•	Established a comprehensive automated testing strategy (JUnit 5, Mockito, REST-assured, Cucumber/Karate, PIT), improving code coverage and significantly reducing production defects.
	•	Enhanced observability using Grafana and Splunk, enabling proactive monitoring and alerting, reducing mean-time-to-detect and resolve (MTTD/MTTR) by an estimated 30–50%.
	•	Drove CI/CD and release automation using Harness and Git-based workflows, improving deployment frequency and reducing release cycle times across services.
	•	Owned end-to-end delivery lifecycle including Kubernetes deployments, ServiceNow change management, and Agile execution using JIRA, supporting frequent, reliable releases.
	•	Led vulnerability remediation efforts and embedded secure coding practices into SDLC, strengthening application security posture and compliance.

positions.title: Accounts Receivable Clerk
positions.description:
•	Resolve authorized credits by entering into the, Epicor Prophet 21, distribution software.
•	Successfully complete data entry task such as: credit/billing and tracking using Microsoft Excel.
•	Locate and apply credit memos to respective invoices.
•	Efficiently handle administrative duties (e.g., scanning, billing and bookkeeping) that allow customers to submit payments.
•	Obtain proof of delivery for customers using Beavex as well as filed Logistics manifests.
•	Scan, email, and mail weekly invoices to customers as well as using SQL based Prophet 21 to email weekly invoices.
•	Accomplish accounting and organizational tasks by completing related duties as ne

positions.title: Medical Office Specialist
positions.description:
•	Managed and created a welcoming environment in the reception for patients, and provided basic orientation to the center and all available services.
•	Obtained accurate and complete personal information from each patient as required for registration and entered into the Electronic Medical System (EMS).
•	Efficiently handled administrative duties (e.g., answering phones, scheduling appointments, maintaining medical records, patient processing, billing and bookkeeping) that allowed doctors and nursing staff to focus on the health concerns of their patients.
•	Help implement health center quality assurance and control program efforts ensured through compliance with HIPAA regulations; improved patient care/satisfaction.
•	Coordinated with the medical staff, to ensure an effective workflow, by assuring patients are being checked in and out on a timely fashion by using the eCW system.
•	Performed financial assessments of all new patients and reassessment of established patients upon their visits to verify eligibility.
•	Assisted in the preparation of applications for public entitlements and facilitated the approval process.
•	Prepared all patient mail correspondence to be delivered to their homes providing updates and appointment reminders.
